title: Japan Corporate IR & Disclosure Extractor Input

sourcePresets.title: Public Japanese Financial & IR Presets
sourcePresets.description: Curated unauthenticated public Japanese disclosure feeds to fetch. Supported presets: tdnet_recent, jpx_markets, jpx_news, boj_whatsnew, meti_releases, prtimes_all.

feedUrls.title: Custom IR / RSS / Atom / JSON Feed URLs
feedUrls.description: Additional HTTP(S) corporate IR or disclosure feeds (RSS 2.0, RSS 1.0 RDF, Atom 1.0, or JSON).

stockCodes.title: Filter by TSE Stock Codes
stockCodes.description: Optional list of 4-character Japanese securities codes (e.g. '7203', '141A'). Leave empty to include all companies.

categories.title: Filter by Disclosure Categories
categories.description: Optional disclosure category filter: earnings_revision, buyback, dividend, m_and_a, guidance, governance, other.

keywords.title: Filter by Keywords
keywords.description: Optional keywords matched case-insensitively against title, summary, and company name.

maxItemsPerFeed.title: Max Items Per Feed
maxItemsPerFeed.description: Maximum number of disclosure records parsed from each feed.

deduplicateByUrl.title: Deduplicate Records by URL
deduplicateByUrl.description: Skip duplicate announcements sharing the same normalized URL across feeds.
